Thermaltake Smart Series
Incorporating various high-quality components, the Smart Series – models are rated from 500W to 700W – saves energy through its high efficiency of up to 80% and accommodates any mainstream build with the most demanding requirements. An embedded intelligent cooling fan delivers excellent airflow at an exceptionally low noise level. Additionally, the Single +12V rail design enables non-stop usage with stable and reliable performance.
120mm Ultra Quiet Fan
Smart Series adopt 120mm cooling fan delivers excellent airflow at an exceptionally low noise level.
Multiple Connectors
The cables used for Smart Series are black and low-profile, users are able to properly route the cables in optimal location to prevent airflow blockage.
